notes: The implementation preserves the reference split composition: oversized left typography, volleyball focal object, dark court depth and violet action hierarchy.
The CSS-rendered volleyball is intentionally lighter than the photorealistic reference asset, while keeping the approved volumetric lighting and panel language without WebGL.
Mobile screens and the control room use the same token system, glass surfaces, court lines and one-accent palette rather than imitating the board as a single static mockup.
